scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Chain of Command
cards.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I lend you this ladder, your department head must ask mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to establish departmental boundaries.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while the gutter committee remains unformed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I lend you this ladder, your department head must ask mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're neighbours, cleaning gutters. My wife sent me over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then her request should go to my wife. I can supply the ladder's dimensions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your wife's away. She left you in charge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then address it to me as acting head. I'll forward it to her for confirmation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requires department heads to communicate, but A5's unformed committee shifts toward establishing authority rather than routing through it.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's neighbor context; B4 repeats the borrowing request and gives A5 no distinctive new information.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies the shared gutter task, but B4 does not change B's strategy or A's available choices.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds an unformed committee to the boundaries already demanded by A3, without a new partner-caused obstacle.

specificity.evidence: A1's ladder and B2's neighboring gutter cleaners establish a concrete domestic situation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's gutter committee is compact but feels like a second bureaucratic label after A3's departmental boundaries.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands department-head routing; A3 maps spouses into that hierarchy; A5 subjects acting authority to confirmation above.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's wife-sent errand informs A3's spouse-to-spouse route; B4's delegation informs A5's acting-head procedure.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs a neighbor's ladder for gutters and B4 removes the absent-wife obstacle through an existing delegation.

heightening.evidence: B4 gives A authority, and A5 uses that authority to create a formal request that still travels upward.

specificity.evidence: B2 establishes neighbors cleaning gutters and A3 offers ladder dimensions; A1 deliberately begins with a misplaced office vocabulary.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's dimensions-only contribution and A5's acting-head title earn humor through procedural avoidance, with somewhat formal phrasing.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies the domestic relationship and wife's request; A3 converts those facts into a hierarchy between households.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 names A as delegated substitute; A5 adopts acting-head status while demanding confirmation from the absent superior.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A routes a neighborly favor through an imagined but consistently applied chain of authority.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: Even gaining authority becomes another procedural step rather than permission to lend the ladder.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A routes a neighbor's borrowing request through household superiors and treats acting authority as another step requiring confirmation.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Power Vacuum: revised B4 identifies an acting head, yet A5 still forwards the request upward rather than merely resolving who is in charge.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 establishes a route between spouses; B4 temporarily places A in charge, causing A5 to specify acting-head submission and onward confirmation.

records.recommendedEdit: The original B4 does not materially redirect A. The revision preserves ladder lending and procedural routing, adding spouses and an absence as illustrative details. Second internal read: fidelity 5 (A3/A5), logic 5 (B2/A3; B4/A5), relationship 4 (B offers delegated authority), heightening 4 (A5 routes even acting authority upward), specificity 5 (A1/B2), brevity 4 (A3); total 92. Hard gates pass; under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: The household hierarchy is a conspicuous comic premise rather than an established practical arrangement. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The acting-rank move resembles the supplied causal reference; the household loan and spousal route provide a different context, but the structural overlap remains.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b makes hierarchy survive a domestic correction and delegation; a adds an institutional layer after a rank revelation.
